answer.reason: The verses give two things that belong to the city's church: the rebuke in the letter to Laodicea, and the instruction that the epistle be read there.

clauses.english: was rebuked as lukewarm, neither cold nor hot
clauses.quote: because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot

clauses.english: was to have Paul's letter read in its church
clauses.quote: cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans

doubts: 1TI 6:21 is excluded because it names Laodicea only in the added subscription, which is not part of Paul's words.
COL 4:16 mentions an epistle from Laodicea, but the verses do not say what it was, so it is left out.
